question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 10.**
solution:
The correct answer is: opportunity

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• "Opportunity" means a chance to do something that you would like to do; a situation or a time in which it is possible to do something that you would like to do.
 
• "Event" means a planned public or social occasion.
 
• "Example" means something such as an object, a fact or a situation which shows, explains or supports what someone says.
 
• "Image" means the general impression that a person or organization gives to the public
 
 
 
• *​*As per the meaning of the given words "opportunity"* *is the appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 1.

Complete Paragraph: *One day, my six-year-old sister (1) asked __us which career she should (2) __opt __for. My father suggested (3) __that __she should become a doctor, (4) __While __my mother said she could (5) __become__ a newspaper reporter. I (6) __believed __she would make a (7) __fine __teacher. After a brief (8) __silence __my sister declared, “I will become (9) **__an __**actress. Then I will get an (10) __**opportunity **__to play all these roles.”*
